correctness.rationale: For an arbitrary incidence edge, the design incidence matrix yields a mean-zero Schur complement scalar lambda*v/k. The exact current potential has values (k-1)/(lambda*v), -1/(lambda*v), 0 across three point classes. Absolute signs are proven for distinguished and nondistinguished blocks using lambda*v>k; strength-three counting gives sum_{T not containing i} b_T(k-b_T)=(k-1)(v-k)(lambda-tau). Subtracting and adding the distinguished-block contribution yields the cycle norm. Symmetric orthogonal matrices give infinity norm equal to one norm. The independently grounded checker confirms 116 columns and all 1,096 analytic-current columns without substituting finite cases for universal proof.

value.rationale: The theorem computes two intrinsic operator invariants for every finite three-design incidence graph independently of edge transitivity, with a closed inverse-pair-incidence correction revealing dependence on design multiplicity. It gives distinct exact norms for complete 4-subset incidence and affine Steiner quadruple incidence on the same eight points; an infinite affine family has explicit limits. The third-order current cancellation is a motivated structural mechanism rather than a routine fixed-size enumeration.
